title: [Main][all-e]Changing Negative Amount Format to Parentheses modifies displayed decimal precision despite unchanged rounding settings in the Financial Reports
summary: Fixed an issue where selecting parentheses for negative amounts in Financial Reports incorrectly changed the displayed decimal precision instead of respecting the configured rounding settings.
key_points: Negative amount formatting was using a hardcoded two-decimal pattern instead of the configured precision
The fix applies rounding first, then wraps negative values in parentheses
Preserves existing rounding behavior when changing negative number display format
Updates impact the Matrix Management codeunit and Account Schedule Overview page
Test cases updated across multiple localization layers to reflect corrected behavior
quote: Format the amount using the configured precision first, then wrap negative values in parentheses.
